title: Only response filters may self-authorize a route in the fail-closed backstop
answers: which after-request handlers exempt a route from the auth backstop
why does adding a set_can_manage grant not authorize a route
add a new response filter to basic-auth without validator
fail-closed check for routes without before-request validator
body:
Invariant: a route is exempt from the fail-closed backstop only when its after-request handler is in _SELF_AUTHORIZING_AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS (the filter_* and redact_* response filters). Ownership grants (set_can_manage_*) and permission cleanups (e.g. _cleanup_workspace_permissions) do not exempt a route.
Enforced by: mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_authorized_outside_before_request, which checks AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS.get((path, method)) and each WORKSPACE_PARAMETERIZED_AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS entry against that set.
Skipping this: a write route that only registers an after-request grant becomes reachable with no validator, so its create is never checked.
Coverage: tests/server/auth/test_authorization_coverage.py:test_every_ownership_grant_route_has_a_before_request_validator fails when a set_can_manage_* route lacks a before-request validator; tests/server/auth/test_fail_closed_flag.py:test_ownership_grant_after_handler_does_not_authorize_route pins the exemption.
Constraints: a new response filter must be added to the set to self-authorize; a new ownership grant must not be added.
applies: Any new route or after-request handler in the basic-auth app (mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py) that filters, redacts, grants ownership, or cleans up permissions.
says: Unauthorized users can trigger actions that grant ownership without prior permission checks.
Ensure write actions verify permissions before creating resources or updating access rights.
Users without access rights are able to hit endpoints that assign permissions.
Why does granting management rights to an item fail the security check?
Allow endpoints that filter sensitive response data to pass the authorization check.
search: In basic-auth fail-closed routing, only after-request response filters in _SELF_AUTHORIZING_AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS exempt a route from the authorization backstop. Handlers that grant ownership like set_can_manage_* or clean up permissions like _cleanup_workspace_permissions do not exempt a route. Enforced in mlflow/server/auth/__init__.py:_authorized_outside_before_request by checking AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS and WORKSPACE_PARAMETERIZED_AFTER_REQUEST_HANDLERS. New response filters must be added to the set to self-authorize, while ownership grant routes must include before-request validators as tested in tests/server/auth/test_authorization_coverage.py and tests/server/auth/test_fail_closed_flag.py.
